sections.name: StreamDelayBadge
sections.title: Live or recorded status sentence
sections.what: Picks the sentence: either how many seconds behind a live feed is, or Not live with the recording date in UK style, read in UTC. Shows it in the badge.
sections.why: Likely reason: states the delay honestly, as the comment requires.
sections.watch_out: The date uses a fixed UK format, and the sentence is not translated.

summary: A badge that says whether data is live and how far behind real time it is, or that it is a recorded replay and when it was recorded.
purpose: Stops users from mistaking old or replayed data for live data.
why: The comment says recorded replays must state they are not live and give the recording date, and a live feed must state its measured delay.
how: Given either a live flag with a delay in seconds, or a not-live flag with a recording time, it writes the matching sentence and shows it in a badge.
inputs: Either a live value with delaySeconds, or a not-live value with recordedAt.
risks: An invalid recording time shows as Invalid Date. The delay is rounded to whole seconds.
debug: If the wrong sentence shows, check the live flag. If the date is wrong, check the recordedAt text and the UTC setting.
